title: Benchmark Saturation Detector: Identifying When Models Have Effectively 'Solved' a Safety Benchmark

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Useful meta-level tool for benchmark maintenance. However, saturation detection is more of a community health metric than a direct safety contribution. Impact depends on the community adopting the metric.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Entirely based on collecting publicly available scores and computing basic statistics (mean, variance, skewness). No model training, no API calls needed. Standard Python/pandas. Highly accessible for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Collecting public scores, computing distributions, and visualizing is well-bounded. The main effort is finding and cleaning the data. A dashboard is optional polish. Easily achievable in 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
